poll.source_locator: 'OH-07 General Toplines. Online sample of 635 likely voters fielded over web panels and via text-to-web from August 04, 2026 to August 05, 2026 ... The margin of error is 4.8%.' Q11 (with leaners): Democrat Brian Poindexter 54%, Republican Max Miller 46%
poll.notes: out_of_window (field end Aug 5); written because no OH-07 poll with fieldwork on/after Sep 1 was found anywhere. Topline PDF does not print the firm name; attribution to Tavern Research from Wikipedia's OH-07 table, which cites this PDF for the Tavern row (Aug 4-5, 635 LV, 46/54). Release date set to field end; not stated in the PDF. Two-way with leaners pushed, no undecided reported. Later OH-07 polls (co/efficient Aug 5-6; Bedrock Aug 7-10) are seen, unverifiable; see README. New 2026 Ohio map.
